title: Mitigating Strong-Modality Collapse in Multimodal Learning via Inverted Asymmetric Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.26879v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fusing multiple modalities is expected to improve model performance. However, on the MultiHuSE dataset, early, late, and symmetric attention fusion often fail to outperform the best unimodal baseline (text). Pathway isolation of a symmetric attention fusion model reveals that the text-pathway accuracy drops from 74.9% to 56.4% after fusion in one such setting, indicating that the dominant modality can be degraded during integration. We term this strong-modality collapse and argue that it helps explain why some multimodal models fail to surpass unimodal baselines. We propose Inverted Asymmetric Fusion (IAF), which avoids forcing mutual attention across modalities. The dominant modality is preserved by passing through fusion unchanged, while weaker modalities attend to it as a contextual anchor. translated_title: 通过倒置非对称融合缓解多模态学习中的强模态坍缩
translated_abstract: 摘要：融合多种模态预期能提升模型性能。然而，在MultiHuSE数据集上，早期、晚期和对称注意力融合往往无法超越最佳单模态基线（文本）。对称注意力融合模型的路径隔离显示，在一种此类设置中，文本路径的准确率在融合后从74.9%降至56.4%，表明主导模态在整合过程中可能被退化。我们将此称为强模态坍缩，并认为这有助于解释为何一些多模态模型未能超越单模态基线。我们提出倒置非对称融合（IAF），它避免强制跨模态互注意力。主导模态通过保持不变地穿过融合过程来保留，而较弱模态则将其作为上下文锚点进行关注。在融合前，较弱模态通过模态感知知识蒸馏得到增强。我们在三个不同基准上评估了IAF。
tldr: 本文提出倒置非对称融合（IAF）方法，通过保持主导模态不变并让弱模态以其为锚点，结合模态感知知识蒸馏，有效缓解了多模态融合中的强模态坍缩问题，从而超越单模态基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Inverted Asymmetric Fusion (IAF), which mitigates strong-modality collapse in multimodal learning by preserving the dominant modality unchanged and using it as a contextual anchor for weaker modalities, enhanced via modality-aware knowledge distillation, enabling superior performance over unimodal baselines.
